```yaml
name: Changes Filter

on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'lighthouse.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      should-run-tests: ${{ steps.detect-changes.outputs.should-run-tests }}
      should-run-security: ${{ steps.detect-changes.outputs.should-run-security }}
      should-run-validation: ${{ steps.detect-changes.outputs.should-run-validation }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Detect changed files
        id: detect-changes
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: '**/*.{ts,tsx,json,yaml}'

      - name: Determine if tests should run
        id: determine-tests
        run: echo "::set-output name=should-run-tests::$(jq '.added + .modified | length > 0' < $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/changed_files.json)"

      - name: Determine if security should run
        id: determine-security
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=should-run-security::false"
          if [[ $(jq '.added + .modified | contains(["package-lock.json", "yarn.lock"])' < $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/changed_files.json) == true ]]; then
            echo "::set-output name=should-run-security::true"
          fi

      - name: Determine if validation should run
        id: determine-validation
        run: echo "::set-output name=should-run-validation::$(jq '.added + .modified | contains(["README.md", "docs/", "content/"])' < $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/changed_files.json)"

  ci:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should-run-tests == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload test results to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

  security:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should-run-security == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run dependency review
        run: npx dependency-check-cli --scan .

      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit

      - name: Run socket security scan
        run: npx socket-security-scan

      - name: Run secret scanning
        run: npx secretlint

  validation:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should-run-validation == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run PR label validation
        run: npx pr-label-validator

      - name: Run validation report
        run: npx validate-report

  dead-code-detection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run dead code detection
        run: npx eslint --ext .js,.jsx,.ts,.tsx .
```
